Summary: US-01 Register a patient account
Description:
As a visitor, I want to register with my mobile number, so that I can request appointments online without calling the hospital.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given I am on the Register page and my mobile number has no account, When I submit full name, a valid 05XXXXXXXX number, date of birth and two matching valid passwords, Then a Patient account is created, I am logged in and I see My Requests.
AC2. Given my mobile number already has an account, When I submit the form, Then no account is created and the form says the number is already registered.
AC3. Given my password has fewer than 8 characters or no digit, When I submit the form, Then the password rule is shown next to the field and nothing is saved.

Traceability: FR-01 | US-01 | UC-01 | TC-01
API: POST /api/v1/auth/register
Page: Register page

Summary: US-02 Log in
Description:
As a patient or receptionist, I want to log in with my mobile number and password, so that I can reach the pages of my role.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given I have an account, When I enter the correct mobile number and password, Then I am logged in; a patient sees My Requests and a receptionist sees the Requests Dashboard.
AC2. Given I have an account, When I enter a wrong password, Then I see that the mobile number or password is incorrect, without saying which.
AC3. Given I failed to log in 5 times in a row, When I try again within 15 minutes, Then login is refused and the message says when I can try again.

Traceability: FR-02 | US-02 | UC-02 | TC-02, TC-16
API: POST /api/v1/auth/login, GET /api/v1/auth/me
Page: Login page

Summary: US-03 Log out
Description:
As a logged-in user, I want to log out, so that nobody else using this device can see my data.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given I am logged in, When I click Log out, Then my token is deleted and I return to the Clinics page.
AC2. Given I have logged out, When I open a protected page such as My Requests, Then I am sent to the login page.

Traceability: FR-03 | US-03 | UC-03 | TC-03
API: none (token removed in the browser)
Page: Header menu

Summary: US-04 Browse clinics
Description:
As a visitor or patient, I want to see the clinics with their location and working hours, so that I can choose the right clinic and day.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given active clinics exist, When I open the Clinics page, Then I see each active clinic's name, description, location and working days and hours.
AC2. Given a clinic is inactive, When I open the Clinics page, Then that clinic is not listed.

Traceability: FR-04 | US-04 | UC-04 | TC-04
API: GET /api/v1/clinics, GET /api/v1/clinics/:clinicId
Page: Clinics page

Summary: US-05 Search and filter clinics
Description:
As a visitor or patient, I want to search clinics by name and filter them by day, so that I find a suitable clinic quickly.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given I am on the Clinics page, When I type part of a clinic name, Then only clinics whose name contains that text are shown.
AC2. Given I am on the Clinics page, When I choose a working day, Then only clinics open on that day are shown; with no match I see a "no clinics found" message.

Traceability: FR-05 | US-05 | UC-05 | TC-05
API: GET /api/v1/clinics?search=&day=
Page: Clinics page

Summary: US-06 Submit an appointment request
Description:
As a patient, I want to request an appointment at a clinic on a preferred date, so that I get an appointment without phoning the hospital.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given I am logged in and the clinic is active, When I pick one of its working days between tomorrow and 30 days ahead and click Submit, Then a request is created with status Pending and I see its number, e.g. AH-2026-00042.
AC2. Given I am logged in, When I pick a day the clinic does not work, or a date outside the allowed range, Then no request is created and I see which rule failed.
AC3. Given I already have an active request for the same clinic and date, or 3 Pending requests, When I click Submit, Then no request is created and I see the reason.
AC4. Given I am not logged in, When I click Request appointment on a clinic, Then I am sent to the login page and returned to the form after logging in.

Traceability: FR-06 | US-06 | UC-06 | TC-06, TC-15
API: POST /api/v1/appointments
Page: New Request page

Summary: US-07 View my requests
Description:
As a patient, I want to see all my requests and their status, so that I know which ones are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given I have requests, When I open My Requests, Then I see request number, clinic, preferred date and status for each, newest first.
AC2. Given I have no requests, When I open My Requests, Then I see an empty-state message and a link to the Clinics page.

Traceability: FR-07 | US-07 | UC-07 | TC-07
API: GET /api/v1/appointments/mine
Page: My Requests page

Summary: US-08 Track a request by number
Description:
As a patient, I want to open a request by its number, so that I can see the confirmed time or the rejection reason.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given request AH-2026-00042 is mine, When I search for that number, Then I see its status, clinic and date, plus the time and note if Confirmed, or the reason if Rejected.
AC2. Given the number does not exist or belongs to another patient, When I search for it, Then I see "request not found" and no other patient's data.

Traceability: FR-08 | US-08 | UC-08 | TC-08
API: GET /api/v1/appointments/:requestNumber
Page: Request Details page

Summary: US-09 Cancel a request
Description:
As a patient, I want to cancel a request I no longer need, so that the time goes to another patient.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given my request is Pending or Confirmed and its date is at least one day away, When I click Cancel and confirm, Then its status becomes Cancelled.
AC2. Given my request is Rejected or Cancelled, or its date is today or past, When I open it, Then no Cancel button is shown, and the API refuses a cancellation call.

Traceability: FR-09 | US-09 | UC-09 | TC-09
API: PATCH /api/v1/appointments/:requestNumber/cancel
Page: Request Details page

Summary: US-13 Add and edit clinics
Description:
As a receptionist, I want to add and edit clinics and their working hours, so that patients always see correct information.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given I filled name, description, location and at least one working day whose start is before its end, When I click Save, Then the clinic is saved and appears in the clinic list.
AC2. Given the name already exists, or a day's end time is before its start time, When I click Save, Then nothing is saved and the error is shown.

Traceability: FR-13 | US-13 | UC-13 | TC-13
API: GET/POST /api/v1/admin/clinics, PUT /api/v1/admin/clinics/:clinicId
Page: Manage Clinics page

Summary: US-14 Deactivate or reactivate a clinic
Description:
As a receptionist, I want to deactivate a clinic temporarily, so that patients cannot request a clinic that is not running.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given a clinic is active, When I deactivate it, Then it disappears from the public list, new requests for it are refused, and its existing requests stay unchanged.
AC2. Given a clinic is inactive, When I reactivate it, Then it appears in the clinic list again.

Traceability: FR-14 | US-14 | UC-13 | TC-14
API: PATCH /api/v1/admin/clinics/:clinicId/status
Page: Manage Clinics page

Summary: US-10 Review appointment requests
Description:
As a receptionist, I want to see and filter all requests, so that I handle the pending ones first.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given I am logged in as a receptionist, When I open the Requests Dashboard, Then I see Pending requests first, oldest first, 20 per page, with patient name, mobile, clinic, preferred date and notes.
AC2. Given I am on the dashboard, When I filter by status, clinic or date, or search a request number or mobile number, Then only matching requests are listed.
AC3. Given I am logged in as a patient, When I open the dashboard address, Then access is denied (HTTP 403).

Traceability: FR-10 | US-10 | UC-10 | TC-10, TC-16
API: GET /api/v1/admin/appointments
Page: Requests Dashboard

Summary: US-11 Confirm a request
Description:
As a receptionist, I want to confirm a request with an appointment time, so that the patient knows exactly when to come.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given a request is Pending, When I enter a time inside the clinic's hours for that day and click Confirm, Then the status becomes Confirmed; the time, my user and the decision time are saved; the patient sees them.
AC2. Given a request is Pending, When I enter a time outside the clinic's hours, Then confirmation is refused and the clinic's hours are shown.
AC3. Given the patient cancelled the request meanwhile, When I click Confirm, Then it is refused with "this request is no longer pending".

Traceability: FR-11 | US-11 | UC-11 | TC-11
API: PATCH /api/v1/admin/appointments/:requestNumber/confirm
Page: Requests Dashboard

Summary: US-12 Reject a request
Description:
As a receptionist, I want to reject a request with a reason, so that the patient understands and can choose another date or clinic.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1. Given a request is Pending, When I write a reason and click Reject, Then the status becomes Rejected and the patient sees the reason.
AC2. Given a request is Pending, When I click Reject with an empty reason, Then the request stays Pending and I am asked for a reason.

Traceability: FR-12 | US-12 | UC-12 | TC-12
API: PATCH /api/v1/admin/appointments/:requestNumber/reject
Page: Requests Dashboard
